text:
raj: Heads up — seeing rapid oscillation in the us-west2 GPU pool. Scale-up then immediate scale-downs. Inference latency spiking.
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: gpu-pool-us-west2 capacity flapping detected. 65% error rate on inference-rt. avg_scale_up=48s, cycles=3/6m.
chelsie: Can you paste `scalectl status gpu-pool-us-west2` and `kubectl get nodes -o wide`?
raj: `scalectl status gpu-pool-us-west2` -> desired=40 current=26 pending=14 cooldown=30s last_scale=12s
alec: cooldown=30s looks dangerous after recent drain changes. If drain/grace < autoscaler cooldown we get thrash.
michael: Also seeing kube-proxy + kubelet NotReady transitions in logs around the same timestamps — some nodes flip back up quickly.
jen: We rolled a config yesterday that shortened node drain grace to 10s during image rollout. That could be the trigger.
chelsie: Immediate mitigation: increase autoscaler cooldown to 180s and set `min_reserved=20` for gpu-pool-us-west2. I can push.
raj: Do it. Also shift 20% of traffic to eu-west1 as a temporary safety valve. Cost will go up but better than errors.
alec: I'll run: `routectl shift --from us-west2 --to eu-west1 --pct 20` and pin dedicated fallback capacity in eu-west1.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: routing change requested by alec — job r-3421 queued
infra-bot: Metric update: us-west2 ready_nodes=19 -> 38 after 2m; observed 3 scale cycles in last 6m. error_rate trending down after partial shift.
michael: Found repeated kubelet OOM messages during startup on several GPU images — driver probe delay causing NotReady and triggering scale-downs.
chelsie: Plan: 1) revert the short drain-grace PR, 2) bump autoscaler cooldown to 180s, 3) reserve 20 nodes for 1h, 4) shift 20% traffic to eu-west1, 5) open incident and start RCA. @sre-oncall please open incident channel.
sre-oncall: Opened incident INC-18417 and created #inc-18417-gpu-flap. Paging oncall.
raj: Thanks — keeping an eye. Can someone confirm PR revert and config roll?
alec: PR merged: revert/short-drain-grace (https://git.redwood/reverts/1234). Rolling config to us-west2 now.
infra-bot: autoscaler-log: `scale-controller`: evaluateScaleUp() -> suppressed by recent-scale threshold; evaluateScaleDown() triggered after node NotReady events.
jen: Confirming post-change: no new thrash in last 10m and p99 latency back to baseline. We'll keep the reserved nodes for 30m then step down.
chelsie: :white_check_mark: Postmortem scheduled T+2h in calendar. Please add traces/plots to the doc.
raj: Good work. Follow-up action items: add a safe cooldown default, add a preflight check when changing drain-grace, and set a regional fallback playbook.
michael: I'll open the follow-up tickets and attach kubelet/drivers logs.
chelsie: Closing thread for now — monitoring live metrics. :thumbsup:
